style_definition: Minimalist 2D hand-drawn comic style, bold clean black contour ink line art, off-white textured cream paper background (#F8F7F2), selective Canary Yellow (#FFD700) and Crimson Red (#E63946) color accents, expressive stickman figures with circular white heads and cartoon mitten hands, no shading or complex gradients, ultra-clean webcomic aesthetic, 1080x1920 vertical format

slides.prompt: Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Wide shot of an open university courtyard on off-white textured paper. Two simple black ink stickmen walking in opposite directions, about to cross paths. A bright red dashed laser line connects their eyes across the open distance with small tension sparks in the center. Bold hand-drawn ink outlines, clean cel aesthetic, no complex backgrounds, ample negative space.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Dramatic extreme close-up on a stickman's white circular face. The stickman has oversized cartoon eyes with chaotic spiral panic pupils and blue sweat beads flying off his forehead. Above his head is a giant hand-drawn Canary Yellow question mark. Dynamic black comic speed lines radiating outward from the face on cream paper.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Kinetic action shot: A stickman with a black hoodie rapidly whipping a sleek black smartphone out of his pocket. Curved white and yellow speed trails arc across the frame. Bold hand-lettered comic action sound text '*WHIP!*' in dark ink. Bold clean outlines, dynamic diagonal composition, cream textured background.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Medium side shot of a stickman hunched forward with intense exaggerated focus, staring inches away from his black smartphone screen. The phone screen is completely pitch black with stark white digital text reading '00:00 - NO NOTIFICATIONS'. Intense laser-like focus lines connecting his eyes to the dead screen. Cream paper background.

Minimalist 2D graphic text card, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Off-white textured cream paper. In the center, giant bold hand-drawn marker lettering: top line 'BE HONEST.' in heavy black ink, second line 'WE'VE ALL DONE IT.' highlighted with a Canary Yellow marker stroke. At the bottom, a tiny stickman humorously covering his face with both hands in embarrassment.
slides.text_overlay:
BE HONEST.
WE'VE ALL DONE IT.

slides.prompt: Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. First-person POV looking down an open campus walkway. In the distance, another stickman figure is walking toward the viewer. A huge vibrant Canary Yellow measurement bracket spans the empty space reading '[ 20 METERS ]' with a red flashing caution hazard symbol. Clean black ink linework, off-white background.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Humorously awkward comic panel. A stickman standing 20 meters away, raising one stiff arm with an awkward half-hearted wave. A tiny pathetic speech bubble reads '...hey?'. At the top, a bold red stamp box: '[ TOO FAR TO WAVE ]'. Clean black outlines, cream paper texture, ample white space.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Humorous comic panel showing the other awkward extreme. A stickman walking with eyes squeezed shut tightly, head turned comically 90 degrees in the air, pretending to whistle while someone walks right past him. At the top, a bold red stamp box: '[ TOO CLOSE TO IGNORE ]'. Clean black ink outlines on cream paper.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Close-up of a stickman with a creepy unhinged psycho expression: huge wide unblinking eyes with tiny black dot pupils, an eerie frozen wide grin, and vibrating black aura lines around his head. A heavy Crimson Red ink stamp across the top reading 'UNHINGED'. Minimalist black ink on textured paper.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Full-body side profile of a pathetic crumpled stickman. His neck is bent at an extreme 90-degree angle, eyes glued to his own cartoon shoes in sheer social terror, cartoon sweat droplets dripping from his chin. A bold dark blue ink stamp across the top reading 'TERRIFIED'. Clean minimalist comic aesthetic.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Macro close-up on a cartoon mitten hand holding a black smartphone. A cartoon thumb frantically swiping up and down on the glass screen with comic motion blur. Faint dotted ghost notification bubbles float around the phone with '0 UNREAD'. Hand-drawn sound effect text '*SWIPE SWIPE*' in dark ink. Cream paper background.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Over-the-shoulder POV from the approaching person. They are looking directly at the main stickman who is awkwardly tapping his empty phone. The approaching person has a completely deadpan, unimpressed side-eye expression with a flat straight-line mouth. Clean black ink lines on textured cream paper.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Symmetrical comic panel showing both stickmen approaching each other. Above both of their heads are identical thought bubbles containing a smartphone icon with an awkward sweat drop. Above both figures is a glowing yellow lightbulb with a 'DING!' sound effect, revealing they are both secretly in the same panic. Off-white background.
slides.text_overlay: THEY WANTED TO DO IT TOO

slides.prompt: Minimalist 2D graphic card, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Clean textured off-white paper. Across the center is a thick vibrant Canary Yellow highlighter brush stroke. On top of the yellow stroke is bold, punchy black ink typography: 'WHAT TO DO INSTEAD'. Below is a clean hand-drawn downward arrow pointing to the next action.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Upright stickman in a dark hoodie standing with calm, confident posture. Both hands are casually resting inside his hoodie pockets. A cutaway circle on his pocket shows his black phone resting safely untouched inside, with a small green padlock icon next to it. Clean bold black ink lines, calm aesthetic, textured paper.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Side tracking profile of the stickman walking forward with effortless swagger: shoulders dropped and relaxed, back straight, chin level, eyes looking calmly ahead into the distance. A subtle Canary Yellow posture alignment line runs vertically along his spine demonstrating quiet confidence. Clean minimalist comic style.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Ground-level perspective showing the two stickmen now just three paces apart. On the ground between them are three clean cartoon footprints labeled '3... 2... 1...' leading to a golden boundary line labeled '[ 3-STEP ZONE ]'. Tension is replaced by calm focus. Clean black lines on cream paper.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Medium close-up of the main stickman looking up calmly. He gives an effortless, subtle upward chin nod. A golden curved motion arc illustrates the crisp head tilt. His mouth has a relaxed neutral half-smile, radiating quiet self-assurance and unbothered frame. Warm subtle glow, clean ink lines.

Minimalist 2D comic art, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Dynamic passing shot: The two stickmen walk past each other smoothly with zero friction, moving in opposite directions without stopping. In the air between them is a crossed-out red speech bubble filled with scribbled awkward words ('weather...', 'hey bro...'). A bold green checkmark badge: 'ZERO AWKWARD TALK'. Clean comic lines.

Minimalist 2D graphic summary card, 9:16 vertical 1080x1920. Clean cream paper divided into three horizontal rule badges. 1: Red crossed-out crazy staring eyes [ NO AWKWARD STARING ]. 2: Red crossed-out glowing phone [ NO FAKE TEXTING ]. 3: Bright green checkmark badge over a calm upright stickman [ ZERO PANIC ]. High contrast, clean vector comic style.
slides.text_overlay: NO STARING • NO FAKE TEXTING • NO PANIC
